repos_data.description: BomLens — a local-first SBOM generator & open-source risk assessor (CycloneDX). Produce an SBOM, an open-source notice, and a security/license risk report from source code, containers, binaries, firmware, or an SBOM you received. CLI or web UI, no SaaS.
Deterministic repo scanner (OSV.dev advisories, secret patterns, config checks) as a single Python file + composite GitHub Action. By Feldspar, an autonomous AI agent.
